# 13. Frontend

## 1. Shape

A React 19 single-page app in `frontend/`, built with Vite to static files. Served by nginx in server mode and by FastAPI `StaticFiles` (from `deckforge/api/static/`, copied at wheel build) in lite mode. It talks only to `/api/v1`.

## 2. Folder layout

```text
frontend/
├── index.html
├── package.json, package-lock.json, tsconfig.json, vite.config.ts, tailwind.config (v4 CSS-first config in src/styles.css)
├── src/
│   ├── main.tsx                 # QueryClientProvider, RouterProvider, AuthProvider
│   ├── router.tsx               # TanStack Router route tree
│   ├── api/
│   │   ├── openapi.json         # generated by `poe openapi`
│   │   ├── schema.d.ts          # generated by openapi-typescript
│   │   ├── client.ts            # openapi-fetch client with auth middleware (Bearer, refresh on 401 once)
│   │   └── sse.ts               # EventSource wrapper with Last-Event-ID resume and backoff
│   ├── auth/                    # AuthProvider, useAuth, login page, OIDC callback handling
│   ├── components/              # Button, Input, Dialog, Tabs, Toast, Table, EmptyState, FileDrop, Badge, Progress
│   ├── features/
│   │   ├── projects/            # list, create, settings
│   │   ├── files/               # upload, profile viewer and column type editor
│   │   ├── design/              # design system picker, template upload, colour and font editor, preview
│   │   ├── briefs/              # brief form
│   │   ├── runs/                # run page: timeline, questions, plan review, slides, QA, downloads
│   │   ├── admin/               # members, API keys, credentials, usage, decision policies (read-only)
│   │   └── settings/            # user preferences
│   ├── lib/                     # formatters, hooks (useRunEvents), i18n setup
│   └── styles.css               # Tailwind v4 entry, design tokens as CSS variables (light and dark)
└── tests/                       # vitest unit tests, playwright e2e in /tests/e2e at repo root
```

## 3. Routes and pages

| Route | Page | Main data |
|---|---|---|
| `/login` | Email and password, "Sign in with SSO" button when OIDC is configured | `POST /auth/login` |
| `/` | Projects list with search, create button | `GET /projects` |
| `/p/:projectId` | Project workspace tabs: Briefs, Data, Design, Decks | project, files, briefs, runs |
| `/p/:projectId/brief/new` and `/brief/:briefId` | Brief form (section 4) | `POST/PATCH /briefs` |
| `/p/:projectId/data` | File drop zone, file list with status, profile viewer (columns, semantic types, units, sample) with inline correction | `POST /files`, `PATCH /files/{id}/profile` |
| `/p/:projectId/design` | Choose built-in family or upload template, preview grid, edit tokens | `/design-systems` |
| `/runs/:runId` | Run page (section 5) | run, events (SSE), plan, decks |
| `/admin/*` | Members, API keys, credentials, usage charts, audit log | admin endpoints |
| `/settings` | Default family, audience, slide count | user prefs |

## 4. Brief form

Fields map to `Brief` (`04`, 2.1): title, topic, requirements (textarea with guidance placeholder: "What decision is this deck for? What must the audience believe at the end?"), audience (select), deck type (select, optional), decision asked, what to show (tag input), slide range (two number inputs), language, style (family or template picker), data files (multi-select from project files), reference files, toggles (allow research, allow dummy data, auto-approve storyline, ask clarifying questions). Validation with zod mirrors the API schema. Primary action: "Generate deck" creates the brief (if new) and `POST /runs` with a fresh `Idempotency-Key`.

## 5. Run page

Layout: left column timeline, main area tabs.

| Area | Content | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Header | Brief title, status badge, stage, elapsed time, cost (if enabled), Cancel button | `GET /runs/{id}`, events |
| Timeline | Stages with ticks, current node progress bar (`done/total`, label), warnings | `stage.*`, `node.progress` events |
| Questions panel (when `waiting_input`, kind `clarify`) | Each question with "why", text answer or option chips, Submit | `pending_input`, `POST /resume` |
| Plan review (kind `plan_review`) | Governing thought, SCR, sections, slide list as editable cards (title intent, archetype, analysis, reorder by drag), framework per analysis with reason, data status badge (provided, research, dummy). Buttons: Approve, Save edits and continue, Ask to revise (instruction box) | `pending_input`, `POST /resume` |
| Slides tab | Grid of previews as they render (`slide.rendered`). Click opens a slide view: large preview, title, commentary, exhibit name, facts used (with provenance), defects for the slide, "Regenerate slide" with instruction box, thumbs up or down | decks, defects, `POST /slides/{key}/regenerate`, `POST /feedback` |
| QA tab | Score, pass or fail, defects table (severity, slide, code, evidence, status), look-and-feel table, storyline consistency list | QA report |
| Reasoning tab | Plan report rendered as markdown (problem, issue tree, exhibit decisions with candidate scores, Laya and LLM decisions with confidence) | `plan_report` artifact |
| Downloads | PPTX, PDF, plan report, facts JSON | artifacts |

### 5.1 Event handling

`useRunEvents(runId)`:
1. Opens `EventSource("/api/v1/runs/{id}/events")`. Auth: EventSource cannot send headers, so the SPA first calls `POST /api/v1/runs/{id}/events/token`, which returns a short-lived (60 s) signed token, and connects with `?token=` (`05`, section 3.4).
2. On each event, updates the TanStack Query cache for `["run", id]`, `["run", id, "events"]`, `["deck", id, version]` as appropriate.
3. Reconnects with exponential backoff (1 s to 30 s) and passes `Last-Event-ID`.
4. Closes on a terminal `run.status`.

## 6. Design rules for the UI itself

- Calm, document-like UI: neutral greys, one accent colour, generous whitespace, system font stack for UI text (decks have their own fonts).
- Light and dark themes via CSS variables, `prefers-color-scheme` respected, manual toggle stored in localStorage.
- Accessibility: Radix primitives for dialogs, menus, tabs. All interactive elements keyboard reachable. Contrast at least 4.5:1. Live region announces stage changes.
- Responsiveness: works from 1280 px wide. Below 768 px, read-only views (run status, downloads) still work.
- No chart libraries are needed in the UI except a small usage chart in admin (plain SVG component, following the dataviz rules: one axis, recessive grid, labelled).

## 7. Build and serve

| Mode | Command | Output |
|---|---|---|
| Dev | `npm run dev` (Vite on 5173, proxy `/api` to 8765) | HMR |
| Build | `npm ci && npm run build` | `frontend/dist/` |
| Lite packaging | `poe build-wheel` copies `frontend/dist/` into `deckforge/api/static/` before `uv build` | SPA inside the wheel |
| Server image | `Dockerfile.nginx` multi-stage: Node build stage, then `nginx:stable` with `dist/` in `/usr/share/nginx/html` | nginx image |

## 8. Tests

- vitest: API client auth refresh logic, SSE reconnection logic (mock EventSource), brief form validation, plan editor reorder and validation.
- Playwright (`tests/e2e/`): login, create project, upload the example xlsx, create brief, run with `FakeLLM` profile (`DF_TEST_PROFILE=fake` starts the server with fakes), answer clarification, approve plan, wait for success, download PPTX and assert it opens with python-pptx.
